text: 财政部等三部门发布关于调整部分电池消费税政策的公告。为进一步完善消费税制度，现将电池消费税政策调整事项公告如下： 一、自2026年9月1日起，对无汞原电池、金属氢化物镍蓄电池（又称氢镍蓄电池或镍氢蓄电池）、锂原电池、锂离子蓄电池、全钒液流电池按照2%税率征收消费税；自2027年9月1日起，对上述电池产品按照4%税率征收消费税。
text_en: The Ministry of Finance and two other departments issued a notice adjusting the consumption tax policy on certain batteries. To further refine the consumption tax system, the battery consumption tax policy adjustments are announced as follows: 1. From September 1, 2026, mercury-free primary batteries, nickel-metal hydride batteries, lithium primary batteries, lithium-ion batteries, and all-vanadium redox flow batteries shall be taxed at a rate of 2%; from September 1, 2027, these battery products shall be taxed at a rate of 4%.
